training_data.name: Shifaa Arabic Mental Health Consultations
training_data.quote: Following up the Fine-Tuning of SDAIA | سدايا 's LLM Allam-7B to be fine-tuned with the dataset: Shifaa Arabic Mental Health Consultations, the model was finalised and finished, and provided great results when run on Kaggle.

description.text:
- **Developed by:** Mohammed Abdullah Ba'ashar-mabaashar
- **Website:** https://www.bytsnbytes.com
- **License:** apache-2.0
- **Finetuned from model :** humain-ai/ALLaM-7B-Instruct-preview

use_claim.quote: creating a more natural and empathetic tone for therapeutic contexts.

serving.notes: generation_config.json sets max_length 4096 and does not set temperature, top_p, or top_k. The sampling values above are from the card's inference example. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key. The template inserts a system message only when the caller supplies one (<<SYS>>). The example loads the model with load_in_4bit for inference. https://www.bytsnbytes.com is linked on the card and was not opened.

evaluation_reported.text: The custom fine-tuning approach significantly improved model accuracy, achieving an 84.21% alignment with dialectal Arabic and successfully reducing "Modern Standard Arabic leakage" down to just 6.21%, creating a more natural and empathetic tone for therapeutic contexts.

discrepancies: The model card says fine-tuned and does not name a loss, LoRA, or a dataset. The author's LinkedIn post names Shifaa Arabic Mental Health Consultations for this model; the allowed source_type labels do not include that post, so the URL is the post. Same-author adapters mabaashar/allam-7b-mental-health-lora-2 (LoRA r=16 on humain-ai/ALLaM-7B-Instruct-preview) and mabaashar/allam-7b-arabic-mental-health-lora (LoRA r=8, base_model unsloth/llama-3-8b-Instruct-bnb-4bit, tags lora and sft) do not print this repository id, so their ranks are not recorded here. The Unsloth sentence is on the lora-2 card, not on this card.
